opening.argument: The available material promotes an automated cryptocurrency arbitrage bot as a financial participation offer, identifying an “online desktop contract arbitrage bot” and describing automated buying and selling across markets to capture price differences. The frame reinforces that promotion with the phrase “smart contract arbitrage bot” and a stated “Bonus 20%.” It further emphasizes MetaMask support, no additional charges, security, and user control of private keys, presenting trading through the wallet as accessible with only a few taps. Those combined claims establish the promotional mechanism, while the record does not establish the wallet's operation, asset transfers, or transaction outcomes. The fee language is also conflicting, so the evidence supports the stated offer without establishing losses or completed returns.
